messages:
anya: Quick async check-in — posted latest perf run for the continuous-batching + KV warmup changes. TL;DR: short-seq throughput up ~8-12% and token cost looks down ~10%, BUT coldstart p95 on raptor-kernel jumped ~40ms after the prefetch change. Need owners and next actions. Link: https://perf.gist/raptor-1763337

mike: saw the same numbers, nice on cost. where exactly did the coldstart regression appear (init vs first token)?

anya: it's during kernel init path — most of the delta is in kv init + job dispatch. first-token latency unaffected for warm pods.

sanjay: I can take the prefetch heuristics audit. suspect parallel_fetches=3 is saturating the driver scheduler on small GPUs. will dig into traces.

tayla: tagging rollout concerns — can we hold the canary? current canary has ~1.2k requests/min. ops-bot shows 3% error spike on one region.

ops-bot: Canary metrics (region us-west-2): p50=18ms p95=142ms errors=3.1% (up from 0.6%). No pod restarts.

leo: PR #3421 added the aggressive prefetch window. if we revert to window_ms: 30 it might remove the coldstart cost. I can open a revert if we decide.

mike: I'm volunteering to own kernel fallback change (make fallback fast-path bypass prefetch during init). will branch and add tests.

anya: thanks @mike, @sanjay for heuristics. @leo please hold off revert until we evaluate fallback — prefer targeted fix.

build-bot: build status for branch continuous-batch-opt: all tests passed except integration-timeout (flaky).

sanjay: quick config I want to try (local):
```yaml
prefetch:
  enabled: true
  window_ms: 30
  parallel_fetches: 1
```

tayla: plan for next steps (proposed):
- mike: implement kernel fallback bypass (owner)
- sanjay: run heuristics and revised config A/B on canary
- leo: prepare fast rollback PR if fallback doesn't help
- anya: coordinate canary hold and comms to cs if we keep canary paused

anya: timeline? can we have an initial patch + canary run by EOD? if not, what's ETA?

mike: aiming EOD for a minimal patch (no perf regression expected). if CI passes, canary by tomorrow morning.

sanjay: heuristics pass locally in ~2hrs, then will ship to canary.

leo: rollback PR drafted (https://git.redwood/pr/rollback-3421) but not merged.

anya: perfect. I'll update the sprint board (hotpath -> blocked->in-progress). ping here with short updates. :thumbsup:
